newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.AFRICA BONDS SURGE ON WEAK Q1 GDP DATA, RAND OFF.
newsitem.headline: S.AFRICA BONDS SURGE ON WEAK Q1 GDP DATA, RAND OFF.

text.p: 0800 GMT - South African bond yields continue to fall in brisk mid-morning dealings as players toast unexpected fall in first quarter Gross Domestic Product (GDP). Rand a touch weaker on thin volume as players puzzled
* Seasonally adjusted first quarter GDP fell 0.8 percent from previous 3.3 percent rise. Forecasts were for 2.5 percent rise.
* Benchmark R150 stock last at 14.905 percent from 15.06 percent at 1400 GMT Wednesday.
* Debt dealers say figure puts pressure on central bank to loosen monetary policy.
* Range said hard to call as many players reluctant to take profits just yet.
* Rand just weaker versus dollar in slim turnover. Last at 4.4715/4745 on U.S. unit from 4.4710/4740 late Wednesday.
